title: Newsweek names Flywire to "America’s Greatest Companies"… | Flywire
summary: For the second year in a row, Flywire has been named one of America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek.
body_markdown:
August 31, 2026


For the second year in a row, Flywire has been named one of


[America’s Greatest Companies](https://rankings.newsweek.com/americas-greatest-companies-2026) by


*Newsweek.*


To determine the rankings, the New York City-based Plant-A Insights Group evaluated approximately 4,300 U.S. publicly-traded companies across a 24-month window, analyzing SEC filings, HR analytics, employee reviews, patent activity, and sustainability benchmarks. Out of thousands of eligible businesses, Flywire **earned a spot among the 650 top-scoring companies** .


This recognition highlights corporate excellence across four foundational pillars:


- Financial strength and market performance


- Workforce investment


- Track record of innovation


- Environmental sustainability


"We are incredibly proud to be named on Newsweek’s list of America’s Greatest Companies, this award reinforces what makes Flywire unique - we have the technology and top-tier talent to solve complex payment challenges that others simply cannot touch. This honor speaks to the durability of our business, powered by our FlyMates and the core values of continuous innovation, execution, and global collaboration they uphold,” said Mike Massaro, CEO of Flywire.


To view the full Newsweek list, visit


[https://rankings.newsweek.com/americas-greatest-companies-2026](https://rankings.newsweek.com/americas-greatest-companies-2026) .
